row:
Hi! My name is Tess and I am a Veterinary Nurse!

I have worked in the veterinary industry since I was 17 years old. Ive done everything from general vet nursing, emergency nursing, practice management, social media management to locum vet nursing in the UK! I have two small businesses I run “Vet Nurse School” and “Baby Pets Co.”

I live on the Gold Coast in Australia, right near the beach with my Boston Terrier "Daphne." 

Listen to my Podcast "Vet Nurse Confessions" - https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/tess-nolan

Vet Nurse School Instagram- https://instagram.com/vetnurseschool
Tess Nolan Instagram - https://instagram.com/tessnolan
Vet Nurse School - https://www.vetnurseschool.com
“BABY” My Dog Accessory Label - https://babypetsco.com
